## POST `/api/2.58/certificates`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate` | string | The text of the certificate. |

| `common_name` | string | The common name field listed in the certificate. |
| `country` | string | Two-letter country (ISO) code listed in the certificate. |
| `email` | string | The email field listed in the certificate. |
| `intermediate_certificate` | string | The text of the intermediate certificate chains. |
| `issued_by` | string (read-only) | The party that issued the certificate. |
| `issued_to` | string (read-only) | The party to whom the certificate is issued. |

| `key_size` | integer (int32) | The size (in bits) of the private key for the certificate. Default is 2048 bits for `rsa` key_algorithm, 256 for `ec` and `ed25519`. The `ed448` default key size is 456. This field can only be specified when creating a… |
| `locality` | string | The locality field listed in the certificate. |
| `organization` | string | The organization field listed in the certificate. |
| `organizational_unit` | string | The organizational unit field listed in the certificate. |
| `state` | string | The state/province field listed in the certificate. |
| `status` | string (read-only) | The type of certificate. Valid values are `self-signed` and `imported`. |
| `subject_alternative_names` | array of string | The alternative names that are secured by this certificate. Alternative names may be IP addresses, DNS names, or URIs. |
| `valid_from` | integer (int64) (read-only) | The date when the certificate starts being valid. |
| `valid_to` | integer (int64) (read-only) | The date when the certificate stops being valid. |

| `passphrase` | string | The passphrase used to encrypt `key`. This field can only be specified when importing a certificate and key pair. |
